steps.name: Verify that the Inbox title is displayed
User is logged in. Navigating UI to remove existing account for a clean start
Click on 'Switch Account' icon
Click on 'Manage accounts on this device'
Verify the email account is visible in Manage Accounts
Click on 'Remove Account' icon
Click on 'Remove' button in the dialog
Verify that the Login Screen is displayed
Verify that the Login Screen is displayed
Login to application with user: prodfrugaltest1@qaprod.flock.com
Verifying notifications dialog showed
Verify that the Inbox title is displayed
Verify Bring Emails Now Message
Click on Bring Emails Now Discard Button
Verify that the Inbox title is displayed
ASSERTION: PASSED - Inbox title should be visible

testStage.description: Verify that user cannot login when device is in offline mode

steps.name: 220 - Verify user cannot login when device is in offline mode
User is logged in. Navigating UI to remove existing account for a clean start
Click on 'Switch Account' icon
Click on 'Manage accounts on this device'
Verify the email account is visible in Manage Accounts
Click on 'Remove Account' icon
Click on 'Remove' button in the dialog
Verify that the Login Screen is displayed
Disable internet on device
Enter email address: prodfrugaltest1@qaprod.flock.com
Click on the 'Next' button
Verify offline login error is displayed
ASSERTION: PASSED - Offline login error message should be displayed when attempting to login without internet

parameters.value: Offline login error message should be displayed when attempting to login without internet

Verifying notifications dialog showed
Verify that the Inbox title is displayed
Verify that the Inbox title is displayed
